summary: A member switches votes on the next ballot and {person} gets the vacant seat.
realLife: Jennifer Munro won an appointment in Westbrook after a council member switched votes following a tie among three applicants.
gates: A seat is vacant and the first appointment ballot produced no winner.
weights: A single vote separating finalists increases the effect of a switch.
inGame: needs: successive votes on filling a council vacancy.

turns.what: The second ballot leaves the seat vacant.
turns.pulledBy: Every member repeats the first vote.

turns.what: The council fills the seat at the following meeting.
turns.pulledBy: One member requests time to interview the finalists.
turns.writesBack: The appointment carries the later meeting date.
